dedupe_keys.name: italian civil protection department maps and dashboards risks emergencies pnrr

description: The Italian Civil Protection Department publishes in one section all the maps and dashboards it produces and manages, grouped by risk, by emergency, by the National Recovery and Resilience Plan (PNRR) and by initiative. The risk maps include the meteorological and hydrological alert bulletin and other risk layers, the emergency maps cover the most recent emergencies coordinated by the Department, and the PNRR section tracks measures for which the Department is responsible. The data shown are in some cases supplied by other bodies or gathered with other members of the National Civil Protection Service, and they are made available to professionals, media and citizens. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0 (protezionecivile.gov.it: texts, multimedia and aggregated data on the site under CC BY 4.0). Access is free of charge. Caveats: the section is a set of web maps and dashboards, so downloads depend on each map, and the site is in Italian. Coverage is Italy. It supports hazard exposure analysis and emergency response planning for infrastructure, for example alert levels for floods and landslides and the footprint of recent emergencies; there are no related records in the catalogue yet.
